tagline: With managed warehouse, users can view traces stored in Unity Catalog in the MLflow UI without selecting a SQL warehouse.
what_it_does: With managed warehouse, users can view traces stored in Unity Catalog in the MLflow UI without selecting a SQL warehouse. MLflow runs trace queries on a SQL warehouse that it creates in your workspace when your workspace supports it, and on serverless compute otherwise. Workspace admins can enable Managed Warehouse for MLflow on the Previews page.
why_it_matters: With managed warehouse, MLflow manages an optimized warehouse that can execute these queries with low latency and provide a more interactive experience in the UI.
